game_title: Function Test Arena – Hearth Hall Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall, a warm hearth hall: the frost mage must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frozen golems.
theme: Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall: a warm hearth hall
core_gameplay_loop: In Hearth Hall, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing frozen golems. Each round, a new snowshoes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 100 points of snowshoes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Hearth Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Hearth Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
